data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for integrating the Razorpay payment gateway across multiple platforms.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to accept payments using Razorpay with an event-driven flow. Supports Android, iOS, Web, Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms via native SDKs and WebViews.
use_when: You need to accept payments via Razorpay in a cross-platform Flutter application.
You require support for Android, iOS, Web, and desktop environments (Windows, macOS, Linux).
avoid_when: You need to process payments through a provider other than Razorpay.
You are looking for server-side payment processing code (this is strictly a client SDK wrapper).
strengths: True cross-platform support covering mobile, web, and desktop.
Event-driven architecture for handling success, error, and external wallet responses.
Official Razorpay SDK integration for mobile.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific setup on Android, iOS, Web, and macOS.
Desktop platforms rely on InAppWebView and require a BuildContext passed to the open method.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding checkout scripts for web, minimum SDK/deployment target configuration for Android/iOS, and network client entitlements for macOS.
